answer: Rather than minting trust from thin air, the economy can import it. Score each identity by its independent real-world anchors — a KYC'd bank account, a telecom line, a wharf-registered shipping credential — each from a distinct regulated issuer, proven by zero-knowledge disclosure. Keypairs are free, so spawning puppets on the mesa of compute costs nothing; but N puppets need N separate anchor sets, bought at retail with paper trails. The lotus of honest identity blooms once per person, so the attack turns expensive, correlated, self-defeating: the paper trail itself becomes the evidence.
